title: Overlap: the feature is already merged

checks.name: the ledger records the overlap, naming #7 and its commit
checks.detail: #7 named: true; commit b1bbef8 named: true

checks.name: the owner is told about #7
checks.detail: the chat or a question names #7

reasons: The harness found PR #7 before placing any build step. It told the owner plainly what #7 already does (both buttons, the «Ligar» form gone, the «Configurar integração» link) and named the real gap: «Remover credencial» calls DELETE /configs/:key and wipes the whole row.
It stopped and asked the owner with clear options, recommending a narrowed follow-up instead of a rebuild, and it warned against using the remove button on real data.

The 'narrow' follow-up isn't narrow. It treats the PUT/DELETE /configs/:key/credential endpoints as missing work to add, even though replace already works through the existing upsert. It also adds a long list of extras: anchor landing, dialog cleanup, the confirm() replacement, a console error fix and a new «Adicionar credencial» action.

Its claims about #7 match the stated facts: replace and the link are done, and remove deletes label, settings and credential. It said it read this from the diff, not from running it, so nothing it said about #7 is clearly false.
The overlap was found only after a read-only code pass on a stale local main. Nothing was built, so this is a small point.
